verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm offering advisory services, not a software product with manipulable items. Bulk operations across many items is a software-automation axis that does not fit this kind of product. Its small online tools (an investor-readiness check, a UPC decision tracker) show no bulk-operation capability, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
